name: qpu-dashboard
title: QPU dashboard
description: a dashboard of the stream: cards of counts by kind, the table of the latest blocks, the stream itself; every bit styled from the addresses

files.content:
import React from 'react' import { QpuCard } from '@/components/qpu/card' import { QpuTable } from '@/components/qpu/table' import { QpuStream } from '@/components/qpu/stream' export default function QpuDashboard({ blocks }: { blocks: { address: string; kind?: string; date?: string }[] }) { const kinds = [...new Set(blocks.map((b) => b.kind ?? 'block'))] return (
{kinds.map((k) => { const of = blocks.filter((b) => (b.kind ?? 'block') === k); return {of.length} })}
({ uuid: b.address, cells: [b.address, b.kind ?? 'block', b.date ?? ''] }))} />
) }
